# Draft:List of United States Republican Party presidential candidates

}}
This list details the major Republican Party candidates that have ran in presidential primaries and caucuses. The candidates included are those who received at least one delegate at the convention or won at least one contest during the primaries.
The list is split into two, reflecting the shift from party convention to party primaries as the method of selecting delegates.
